failure_mode_1_signal.detail: The z-score normalizes to the trailing 30-min window. When spread hits +1.5sigma, EXIT at 0.25sigma is triggered within 1-2 bars solely from rolling mean shifting toward current spread. Gross PpT ≈ 0 bps across all 324 parameter combinations.
failure_mode_1_signal.evidence: Win rate 0.7%, net PpT -10.24 bps (= cost only, near-zero gross)

failure_mode_2_cost.description: Canonical 0.05% slippage model at small notional

recommendations: Return to Research Director for signal redesign. Normalize z-score against DAILY spread baseline (multi-day rolling OLS spread mean/std), not 30-min intraday window. See Chan (2013) Table 6.3 — daily OLS z-score, not minute-window z-score.

Engineering Director to initiate SPY/QQQ-specific cost model calibration per QUA-150/QUA-161 process. Realistic slippage for SPY/QQQ: 0.001-0.002% (half-spread). Canonical 0.05% model is appropriate for mid-cap equities, not mega-liquid ETFs.
Consider larger capital base (>250K per leg) to amortize fixed costs if canonical model must be used.

pdt_assessment.detail: Strategy requires >3 day trades per 5 rolling days. Requires PDT designation. At 5K, PDT is available but MDD risk endangers PDT threshold. Recommended minimum: 0K.
